## Lecture outline

::: {.lec-outline}
::: {.lec-group}
### Motivation

- Motivation for combining fuzzy logic and neural networks
- Ball-and-beam engineering example
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Fuzzy building blocks

- Fuzzy membership functions
- Takagi-Sugeno rules
:::

::: {.lec-group}

- Five-layer ANFIS architecture
- Worked numerical examples

::: {.lec-group}

- Least-squares estimation of consequent parameters
- Gradient-based adjustment of membership functions
- Hybrid learning
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Dynamic system identification

- ANFIS for dynamic system identification
- Rule explosion
- Grid partitioning versus clustering
- Model validation
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Comparison

- Comparison of fuzzy, neural, and ANFIS models
